details: This package is an install-time beacon with no code: its tarball contains only a package.json (no JavaScript), whose preinstall lifecycle hook runs a quiet wget to hxxp://google[.]com/?user=$(pwd). Installing it therefore performs an unauthenticated HTTP request that transmits the installer's absolute install directory path as a query parameter. The manifest also sets config.unsafe-perm=true. The package contains no code that reads or transmits credentials, environment values or file contents.
